---
name: Feature request
about: Something vtee should be able to do
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**What are you trying to do?**

The task, not the feature. For example: "assert that a menu entry is highlighted in a test", or "let a second
person watch my session read-only".

**What happens today**

What you tried, and what stopped you. Link the documentation page if it is unclear.

**What would help**

A sketch of the command, flag or JSON field you have in mind, if you have one. It is fine to leave this blank.

**Who is it for**

A person at a terminal, an AI agent, or a test harness? On Linux, Windows or both?

**Willing to help?**

[Extending vtee](https://github.com/huntwj/vtee/blob/main/docs/development/extending.md) lists the files a
change like this touches.
